AmazonThunderstroke.name: Thunderstroke
AmazonThunderstroke.description: Increase the damage of Lightning Fury by 20. Quest: Lightning Fury's damage is increased by 1.5 every time it hits a Hero.

AmazonImpale.name: Impale
AmazonImpale.description: Increase Fend's cast range and radius by 25%. It deals an additional 70% damage to enemies below 50% Health.

AmazonChargedStrikes.name: Charged Strikes
AmazonChargedStrikes.description: Gain 15% Attack Speed. Every 3rd Basic Attack deals 20% bonus damage and bounces to nearby enemy Heroes.

AmazonPlateoftheWhale.name: Plate of the Whale
AmazonPlateoftheWhale.description: Regenerate 6 Health per second while Avoidance is active. If fully charged, gain an additional 12 Health per second.

AmazonRingoftheLeech.name: Ring of the Leech
AmazonRingoftheLeech.description: Basic Attacks against your primary target heal for 20% of their damage. If an enemy is Blinded, this also affects Lightning Fury and Fend.

AmazonInnerLight.name: Inner Light
AmazonInnerLight.description: Activate to heal for 25% of your maximum Health over 5 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit with Lightning Fury lower the cooldown of this ability by 10 seconds.

AmazonFendGroundingRod.name: Grounding Rod
AmazonFendGroundingRod.description: Enemies hit by Lightning Fury or Fend are Slowed by 20% for 2 seconds.

AmazonSeraphsHymn.name: Seraph's Hymn
AmazonSeraphsHymn.description: Basic Attacks against your primary enemy Hero grant 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Blinding Light by 2 seconds. Passive: Increase the passive damage bonus of Blinding Light from 15% to 30%.

AmazonSurgeOfLight.name: Surge of Light
AmazonSurgeOfLight.description: After taking 650 damage with Avoidance active, Cassia can activate Avoidance to deal 220 damage to enemies around her.

AmazonBallLightning.name: Ball Lightning
AmazonBallLightning.description: Throw a ball of lightning at an enemy Hero that bounces up to 6 times between nearby enemy Heroes and Cassia, dealing 180 damage to enemies hit.

AmazonValkyrie.name: Valkyrie
AmazonValkyrie.description: Summon a Valkyrie that rushes to Cassia after 0.75 seconds, pulling the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 225 damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds at the end of her path. The Valkyrie knocks back all other enemy Heroes in her way.

AmazonFendWarMatron.name: War Matron
AmazonFendWarMatron.description: Cassia becomes Protected while Channeling Fend and for an additional 1 second if the Channel is completed.

AmazonWarTraveler.name: War Traveler
AmazonWarTraveler.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. While Avoidance is fully charged, gain an additional 10% Movement Speed and Mounting is instant.

AmazonFendGlovesOfAlacrity.name: Gloves Of Alacrity
AmazonFendGlovesOfAlacrity.description: Gain 1 Basic Attack range. While Avoidance is fully charged, gain an additional 1 Basic Attack range.

AmazonPowerStrike.name: Power Strike
AmazonPowerStrike.description: Lightning Fury pierces but only splits on Heroes. Enemy Heroes hit reduce its cooldown by 1 second and become marked for 15 seconds. Upon reaching 3 marks, remove them and cast a Blinding Light at their feet.

AmazonStaticElectricity.name: Static Electricity
AmazonStaticElectricity.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Lightning Fury. Fend's impact launches a lightning bolt towards each nearby enemy Hero.

AmazonMartialLaw.name: Martial Law
AmazonMartialLaw.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Increase this to 3% if they are Stunned, Rooted, Slowed, or Blinded.

AmazonInfiniteLightning.name: Infinite Lightning
AmazonInfiniteLightning.description: Ball Lightning can now bounce indefinitely. Every bounce reduces its cooldown by 4 seconds.

AmazonImprisoningLight.name: Imprisoning Light
AmazonImprisoningLight.description: Upon impaling an enemy Hero, they are Blinded for 5 seconds and Cassia's Valkyrie creates a wave of light that deals 200 damage to nearby enemies. This wave Silences and Roots them for 3 seconds.

AmazonTitansRevenge.name: Titan's Revenge
AmazonTitansRevenge.description: Cassia's Basic Attacks now ignore Armor and while Avoidance is fully charged, they deal an additional 20% bonus damage.

Amazon-AvoidanceRockstopper.name: Rockstopper
Amazon-AvoidanceRockstopper.description: Activate to fully charge Avoidance and increase its Armor value to 60 for 4 seconds. Losing Avoidance removes this bonus.
